run_rouge_calculation: run the rouge_calculation function to compute ROUGE scores between hypotheses and references
run_open_data: run the open_data function to read aligned hypothesis and reference files line by line
run_prepare: run the prepare function to stem all tokens in hypotheses and references using PorterStemmer
run_cli: run the CLI module with --hypotheses and --references flags to compute ROUGE scores
review_rouge_calculation: review the rouge_calculation function that uses the rouge library to compute averaged ROUGE scores
